senses: to be or become many, be or become much, be or become great

strongs.def: properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
strongs.kjv: increase, be many(-ifold), be more, multiply, ten thousands
strongs.from: a primitive root; (compare H7241 (רָבִיב)); also as denominative from H7233 (רְבָבָה)
